parameters.query:
WITH token_row AS (
  SELECT
    t.token_id,
    a.agent_key,
    a.is_active AS agent_active,
    t.revoked_at,
    t.expires_at,
    (t.scopes @> ARRAY['reports:submit']::text[]) AS has_scope
  FROM governance.hub_agent_tokens t
  JOIN governance.hub_agents a ON a.agent_id = t.agent_id
  WHERE t.token_hash = '{{$json.token_hash_sql}}'
  ORDER BY t.created_at_utc DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM token_row) THEN 'unauthorized'
    WHEN (SELECT revoked_at FROM token_row) IS NOT NULL THEN 'unauthorized'
    WHEN ((SELECT expires_at FROM token_row) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT expires_at FROM token_row) <= now()) THEN 'unauthorized'
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT agent_active FROM token_row), false) = false THEN 'unauthorized'
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT has_scope FROM token_row), false) = false THEN 'forbidden'
    ELSE 'authorized'
  END AS auth_status,
  (SELECT agent_key FROM token_row) AS agent_id;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT id AS mission_id FROM governance.missions WHERE mission_key = '{{$json.mission_key_sql}}'
), r AS (
  SELECT id AS repo_id FROM governance.repositories WHERE repo_key = '{{$json.repo_key_sql}}'
), mt AS (
  SELECT id AS mission_task_id, mission_id, repo_id
  FROM governance.mission_tasks
  WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM m)
    AND repo_id = (SELECT repo_id FROM r)
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO governance.reports (mission_task_id, repo_id, head_sha, report_hash, report_payload, ingest_status, submitted_by, source_env)
  SELECT mt.mission_task_id, mt.repo_id, '{{$json.head_sha_sql}}', '{{$json.content_hash_sql}}',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'mission_key', '{{$json.mission_key_sql}}',
           'repo_key', '{{$json.repo_key_sql}}',
           'agent_id', '{{$json.agent_id_sql}}',
           'branch', '{{$json.branch_sql}}',
           'report_md', '{{$json.report_md_sql}}'
         ),
         'accepted',
         '{{$json.agent_id_sql}}',
         'n8n-phase1-authv1'
  FROM mt
  ON CONFLICT (mission_task_id, head_sha) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT mission_id FROM mt)::text AS mission_id,
  (SELECT mission_task_id FROM mt)::text AS mission_task_id,
  (SELECT repo_id FROM mt)::text AS repo_id,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) THEN false ELSE true END AS duplicate_ignored;

INSERT INTO governance.hub_mission_ledger (mission_key, repo_key, stage, actor_agent_key, head_sha, outcome, evidence_json)
VALUES (
  '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.mission_key_sql}}',
  '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.repo_key_sql}}',
  'report_ingest',
  '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.agent_id_sql}}',
  '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.head_sha_sql}}',
  CASE WHEN {{$json[0]?.duplicate_ignored ?? false}} THEN 'duplicate_ignored' ELSE 'accepted' END,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'ccp_ver', '1.0',
    'type', 'mission_report',
    'mission_key', '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.mission_key_sql}}',
    'repo_key', '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.repo_key_sql}}',
    'agent_id', '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.agent_id_sql}}',
    'head_sha', '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.head_sha_sql}}',
    'content_hash', '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.content_hash_sql}}',
    'duplicate_ignored', {{$json[0]?.duplicate_ignored ?? false}},
    'source', 'govhub-n8n'
  )
)
RETURNING ledger_id::text;

UPDATE governance.mission_tasks
SET status = 'completed', completed_at = now()
WHERE id = '{{$node['Insert Report (Idempotent)'].json[0]?.mission_task_id || ''}}'
RETURNING id::text;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT id AS mission_id FROM governance.missions WHERE mission_key = '{{$node['Resolve Auth + Bind Agent'].json.mission_key_sql}}'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT mission_id FROM m)::text AS mission_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance.mission_tasks WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM m)) AS total_tasks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance.mission_tasks WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM m) AND status = 'completed') AS done_tasks,
  ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance.mission_tasks WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM m)) =
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance.mission_tasks WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM m) AND status = 'completed')) AS all_done;
